entities.summary: Qamar Zia is a former field hockey goalkeeper from Pakistan Men's National Hockey Team. He won the bronze medal in 1976 Summer Olympics in Montreal, Quebec, Canada. He also won 1994 Men's Hockey World Cup with Pakistan. He Belongs to Arain family of Sahiwal.
